description: Ecuador, Road Access Constraints is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by WFP - World Food Programme. This dataset shows road access constraints in Ecuador after the earthquake that occurred on 17 April 2016. Coverage: Ecuador. The portal files it under the publisher WFP - World Food Programme. Its tags are earthquake-tsunami, geodata, humanitarian access, logistics, roads. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEOJSON, SHP. The portal shows 2025-08-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution for Intergovernmental Organisations (CC BY-IGO). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
